text:
Spirited evening at the team meeting
Attendees heard from the duty handler
Hugo Dubois, Omar Garcia, and Gus were noted in attendance, along with the senior coordinator and two support staff from Aurelia Skyways.

The team opened with a calm review of how the Companion Animal Travel Desk has been handling recent passenger concerns. The safety reviewer thanked everyone for keeping a warm tone with travelers who arrive anxious, especially when pets seem unsettled. The group agreed that steady reassurance is helping people feel heard, and that simple explanations work best when the desk is busy.

The senior coordinator shared that the check-in flow needs to stay clear and consistent. <<FACT F092>> The group then talked through carrier comfort, document readiness, and the need to avoid rushing any part of the handover. A few examples were discussed where a softer approach helped lower stress for both travelers and pets, and the team welcomed that reminder.

There was also a brief note on communication between desk staff and the duty handler. Everyone supported keeping messages short, direct, and kind, with extra care when a passenger is worried about separation or gate movement. The team felt this approach suits Aurelia Skyways well and supports a safer, more humane service for traveling animals.

The meeting ended with agreement to keep following the current process and to share any concerns early. The meeting ended calmly and on a good note.
